findings.summary: All 70 historical create dispositions point to paths that now exist, contradicting the validator's explicit current-path create predicate.
The later-added U06 unit lacked the complete source denominator bindings and the required current delivery-unit structure, causing serial first-error failures.
The manifest still bound its top-level design and repeated owning-source hashes to pre-remediation bytes, creating honest design-hash drift.
